points.description: States that the company's capital structure (debt-equity mix / financing proportions, hence WACC) stays constant over the projection/forecast period.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if vaguely on track, e.g. mentions constant WACC, constant debt ratio, or capital structure without saying it stays the same over the projection period.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the capital structure (debt/equity mix) stays unchanged over the projection period, in any wording. Give 1 mark for a partial idea such as constant WACC, constant leverage or a stable financing mix with the idea left incomplete. Give 0 for unrelated assumptions such as constant growth or constant cash flows.
